about: A music player for the terminal, inspired by Winamp.

prs.title: Playlists with file:// links now play
prs.broken: Players like VLC save tracks outside the playlist's folder as file:// links. cliamp read those as paths inside the playlist's folder, so the tracks never opened.
prs.changed: A local file:// link now turns into the real path on disk, with spaces and other escaped characters decoded.
prs.matters: Playlists saved by other players open and play in cliamp.

prs.title: Radio and IPTV playlists show the right station names
prs.broken: Radio and IPTV playlists put details such as a logo or group before the station name. cliamp cut the name at the first comma, so a station could show as a broken scrap of those details.
prs.changed: The name now starts after the first comma outside quotes, and durations like 245.7 seconds are read too.
prs.matters: Station lists show real names and lengths, not leftover pieces of tags.
